notes.title: Demo Patch 0.02.01 is LIVE ⚙️
notes.content:
[h1]Caltrops & Weapon / Upgrade UI Patch[/h1][p][i]Hey everyone, its been a while since updating the demo for DRFT. Mostly due to the expectation of our first child in October, but also because i had a LOT in store for you! I really wanted to improve the quality of life and improve the upgrade & weapon flow. So have a look at the new update and the patch notes to find out all about the games improvements![/i]   
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
[/p][h3][b]NEW FEATURE: Added ability to choose your starting weapon[/b][/h3][p]Previously players were always forced to pick the repeater weapon as their starting weapon, but with more weapons coming to DRFT it felt right to give this choice to you as the player. Have a specific combination of weapons in mind? Start off with your most build defining weapon!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471073/326e1fea75f26c978c1379eb8cf0cf1c66e59feb.png"][/img]The new choose weapon menu also gives a sneak peak on new weapons that are currently in development! Newer weapons unlock when you have beat a certain wave. The caltrops weapon is an example of this unlocking once you have made it to wave 10! [/p][h3][b]NEW FEATURE: Added UI widget that shows equipped weapons details[/b][/h3][p]An often heard issue players had was knowing what a weapon exactly did! Now the weapon widget is hoverable while upgrading to see what a weapon actually does! Beside its regular behavior the widget also explains what happens when you are empowered through DRFT.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471073/706538e71da6474a55a771567b6e31ea93b3a720.png"][/img]To help the player understand the impact of upgrades on the weapon the widget actually highlights the weapons that are affected by a specific upgrade. This way you can quickly scan what weapons will be benefitted by a certain upgrade choice. [/p][h3][b]NEW FEATURE: Introduction of the new Caltrops weapon[/b][/h3][p]DRFTs vision has always been a game where you have multiple weapons to play around with 
and that heavily influence the way you beat the waves! Introducing a new weapon called 

[b]CALTROPS[/b]
"Spikes are thrown out of the windows and leave an area that trigger when enemies touch them."

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471073/16a4b6e55e411ba8a941ef17422caa23b5e77b26.png"][/img]This weapon throws a bunch of spikes out of the window behind your car in an area. which can be ugpraded to heavily slow enemies, stun them or even combine all smaller spikes in a gigantic spike that deals LOADS of damage.

The weapon is immediately available for play through the upgrade system, but can also be chosen as a starting weapon as of reaching wave 10!

[/p][h3][b]NEW FEATURE: Weapon types & effects [/b][/h3][p]Previously weapons could get additional tags such as "Kinetic, Blaze, Conduit, Rime or Chaos". Beside allowing you to upgrade multiple weapons at once this system was less impactful than i envisioned previously. Therefore weapons now can only have a single weapon type. 

Beside these changes the weapon types now actually have individual effects that make your weapons more versatile:

[b]Kinetic[/b] - Has a 5% chance to stagger enemies for 0.5 seconds.
[b]Blaze[/b] - Burns enemies and deals 30% damage of the initial hit over 3 seconds.
[b]Conduit[/b] - Has a 5% chance to crit enemies dealing 200% damage.
[b]Rime[/b] - Always slows enemies hit by 25% for 2 seconds.
[b]Chaos[/b] - Randomly deals between 1% and 200% damage.

[u][b]Bugs / fixes:[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the wave text overflowed the UI and was not showing correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the settings menu timeout was not correctly reverting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where wishlist and feedback buttons were not leading to the correct place.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the tooltip fade was not correctly showing when hovering upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the tooltip appear time took far too long to trigger tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the tooltip fade sometimes appeared out of nowhere.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where piercing values for the repeater were not properly counted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the tooltip and settings fades did not correctly apply for widescreen resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where controller support did not function correctly in the upgrade menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced all the enemy and weapon values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the upgrade card descriptions were not always properly formulated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where sometimes upgrades would multiply rather than subtract them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where number popups would persist on screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the depth charge weapon to now shoot multiple projectiles in a short burst.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where area was not applied correctly to the beat blaster weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new gameplay music created by the talented "Hynozia".[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where healthpacks and upgrades could spawn outside of the play area on widescreen monitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced the normal generic upgrades that apply to all weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where spread and pierce were sometimes not properly explained on upgrade cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain upgrades locked stats from being further adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the beat blasters visuals did not correctly reflect the actual area of dealing damage.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.01.03 is LIVE ⚙️
notes.content:
[h2][b][u]Fixes:[/u][/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Fixed a bug with audio settings reverting on launch.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a bug with the settings menu not displaying the correct sound values from load.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a bug in the pathfinding of the chasing enemies.
[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Added new tooltip system for weapon upgrades.[/b][/h2][p]The new tooltip system is designed to give you all the game contextual information you need to make decisions in regards to upgrades. What upgrade is best in the current loadout or situation and how much of a benefit will you gain from it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471073/4242ac96bf44ff24d9426021ffee19ce79a7f816.png"][/img][/p][p]The system currently supports all upgrades available in game and shows multiple game mechanics at once allowing you to scan for keywords in the actual upgrades text.[/p]

notes.title: DRFT Demo - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!

I'm very happy to announce that the open demo of DRFT is finally here!
Throughout the next week i will be keeping an eye out for bugs and feedback given by you while working hard on creating new weapons, enemies, environments and upgrades for the full release.

[b]What can you do in the demo?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Use three different weapons! (The repeater, thumber and depth charge)[/p][/*][*][p]Apply 107 different upgrades to your car![/p][/*][*][p]Beat various enemies and bosses in 20 waves.[/p][/*][*][p]Enjoy the sweet sensation of drifting around while evading all things dangerous![/p][/*][/list][p][b]What quality of life have i added?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play on preferred resolutions (yes even you crazy widescreen people!)[/p][/*][*][p]You can play with a mouse keyboard setup, a keyboard only setup, or make use of any controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Simple settings to make your play session or stream more enjoyable![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]How can you help me?[/b][/p][p]Obviously I've spent a lot of effort on this project and have tried to really create something fun and interesting to play, but also have spent the effort on making the project work seamless on most machines and preferences![/p][p]
[i][u]All I'm hoping for is for you to play the demo, give me your honest opinion and most of all just have fun![/u][/i]
[/p][p]Nonetheless small bugs and problems can arise and I'm super curious about your experience and craziest moments with DRFT! So be sure to join the discord via the link below or leave your comment on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2968670/discussions/0/591775992008302657/"]steam community topic[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks! - Kealo[/p]

notes.title: DRFT - Steam page launch
notes.content:
I'm excited to launch the Steam page for DRFT -- an arcade topdown roguelite where drifting makes you stronger! The projects development is in full swing and new enemies, weapons and upgrades are about to be added on a daily basis!

We are planning to release a public demo in May 2025-- stay tuned!
